tokens.name: color.role.integrity
tokens.notes: Role preservation is a primary characteristic.
tokens.role: Preserve the established meaning of interface colors rather than creating decorative reinterpretations.

tokens.name: form.control.consistency
tokens.notes: Do not redesign each form field as a unique component.
tokens.role: Use familiar, repeated form-control treatments and validation patterns across service steps.

tokens.name: content.task-first
tokens.role: Organize each page around the current service task and next action rather than decorative modules.

tokens.name: adaptation.boundary
tokens.role: Preserve service content before brand spectacle without copying source identity or assets.
